description: This file defines the PhpArrayContainer class, a dependency injection container optimized for Drupal, compatible with Symfony's container, and based on PHP array definitions. It includes methods for constructing services, resolving dependencies, and managing service definitions.

classes.name: PhpArrayContainer
classes.description: A dependency injection container class optimized for Drupal, extending Symfony's Container, with custom service creation and dependency resolution logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the container with a given definition array, setting aliases, parameters, services, and frozen state.

methods.name: createService
methods.description: Creates a service instance based on its definition, handling factory methods, class instantiation, and service configuration.

methods.name: resolveServicesAndParameters
methods.description: Resolves service references, parameters, and special types within argument arrays, supporting nested structures and different argument types.
